response.answer: Recent trends in Humanities, Literature, and Arts focus on collaborative peer-editing and technology-enhanced feedback in ESL classrooms. Research emphasizes hypothesis-driven studies and mixed-method analyses for effective repair strategies. Innovative methodologies include digital platforms for real-time feedback and uptake tracking.
